title: 2026 UK ETS SAF sustainability-criteria alignment QA

sources.title: UK ETS treatment of SAF consultation - accessible webpage
UK ETS: Treatment of sustainable aviation fuel

facts.source_fact: Current UK ETS SAF eligibility requires compliance with RTFO sustainability criteria.
The RTFO has been succeeded by the SAF Mandate for aviation fuels.
The Authority describes a current misalignment between UK SAF supply-side and demand-side policy.
SAF Mandate sustainability provisions are set out in Schedule 1, Schedule 2 and Schedule 3 of the SAF Mandate Order.
The Authority is considering whether UK ETS SAF eligibility should use SAF Mandate sustainability criteria.
The consultation specifically points to Schedule 1 sustainability criteria as a possible UK ETS basis.
The consultation treats the sustainability-criteria decision separately from the emissions-saving-threshold decision.
The current RTFO-linked criteria remain operative unless and until legislation changes.
The SAF Mandate alignment option is intended to reduce policy misalignment.
The consultation does not itself implement the proposed criteria change.
